spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, standing on four thick furry legs. Its overall body shape, fur, head and paws are those of a brown bear, with dense shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle and darker on the limbs, but its back, top of the head, shoulders, hips and shins are covered by a continuous glossy dark brown to nearly black segmented exoskeleton resembling a beetle's armor. A single long, curved, glossy black horn rises from the top of the head. The armor forms overlapping transverse bands over the entire dorsal surface from the head to a short pointed segmented tail, with larger smooth shoulder and hip shields and separate shin guards, while the underside of the chest and belly shows lighter tan segmented plates between the fur and the dark dorsal plates.

parts.looks_like: two small rounded furry ears covered in light brown fur
parts.where: protruding from the sides of the head plate just behind and to either side of the horn base

parts.looks_like: four thick muscular legs covered in shaggy brown fur, with the front pair more vertical under the chest and the hind pair slightly angled under the hips
parts.where: supporting the body from below, two on the near side fully visible and two on the far side partially visible behind them

parts.where: at the bottom of each leg in contact with the ground

parts.looks_like: a short narrow pointed tail made of small overlapping glossy dark rings tapering to a sharp tip and curving slightly downward
parts.where: at the extreme rear left end of the body, extending from the end of the dorsal armor

parts.looks_like: a hard glossy dark brown-black carapace forming a continuous dome over the back, composed of overlapping transverse segments with a smooth reflective surface and small circular pores along the lower edge
parts.where: covering the entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the base of the tail

parts.where: helmet on top of head, shoulder shield behind the neck, hip shield over the hips, shin guards on the outer side of each lower leg, and tan plates on the underside of the neck, chest and abdomen between the fur and the dark dorsal shell

meta_spark.description: The creature is a large quadruped shown in right side profile with the thick shaggy brown fur, head, muzzle, ears, legs and clawed paws of a bear. Its back, top of head, shoulders, hips and outer legs are covered by a glossy dark brown to black segmented exoskeleton like a beetle or pillbug. A long curved black barbed horn rises from the head. A tan segmented under-shell with oval holes is visible on the neck and underside. A small pointed segmented tail extends from the rear of the shell.
